finding.exploit_scenario: Policy "Merchants can update availability" lacks a WITH CHECK clause. However, empirical testing on the local DB confirms direct client exploitation is BLOCKED with "permission denied for table resource_availability" due to 20261031000001_client_grants_lockdown.sql revoking UPDATE on public.resource_availability from authenticated. Retained as Low defense-in-depth hygiene.
finding.required_fix: Add explicit WITH CHECK ((resource_id IN ( SELECT r.id FROM (resources r JOIN providers p ON (r.provider_id = p.id)) WHERE (p.owner_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))))) clause to the UPDATE policy via forward migration.
finding.acceptance_test: Assert RLS policy contains matching WITH CHECK clause and table grants remain locked down to SELECT only for authenticated.
finding.invariant: A merchant never reads or modifies another merchant's data.

finding.cwe: CWE-749: Exposed Dangerous Method or Interface
finding.exploit_scenario: CashfreeCheckoutWebView specifies originWhitelist={["*"]}, permitting the embedded mobile browser to navigate to any external domain. If an unintended redirect occurs or untrusted links are loaded, attacker-controlled scripts could execute in the embedded webview context.
finding.required_fix: Restrict originWhitelist strictly to authorized Cashfree gateway domains and mobile payment application intent schemes: ["https://sdk.cashfree.com", "https://*.cashfree.com", "https://api.cashfree.com", "upi:*", "tez:*", "phonepe:*", "paytmmp:*", "bhim:*", "credpay:*", "intent:*"].
finding.acceptance_test: Verify CashfreeCheckoutWebView rejects arbitrary web navigation while maintaining full support for Cashfree checkout and Indian UPI deep-link apps.
finding.invariant: Service-role keys never reach the client bundle, logs, or WebView.

finding.exploit_scenario: handleMessage accepts postMessage events directly from window.ReactNativeWebView without verifying data structure or origin before dispatching PAYMENT_SUCCESS to the checkout modal. While the backend verification endpoint guards against forged payments, unvalidated client events cause spurious client-side state transitions.
finding.required_fix: Validate message payload structure and discard unknown or untrusted message events with telemetry logging.
finding.acceptance_test: Simulate unvalidated or malformed postMessage events to CashfreeCheckoutWebView; ensure invalid events are ignored and do not trigger onSuccess.
finding.invariant: All payment amounts and split ratios are computed server-side from stored prices.

finding.exploit_scenario: In apps/merchant-web/src/app/api/prescriptions/signed-url/route.ts, authentication bypass header x-test-bypass-user is guarded solely by process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production". If NODE_ENV is misconfigured or unset in non-production environments, an attacker can bypass auth and generate signed URLs for private medical prescriptions.
finding.required_fix: Replace loose NODE_ENV !== "production" check with strict isE2EBypassEnabled() requiring ENABLE_E2E_BYPASS === "true" and a 24+ character secret.
finding.acceptance_test: Adversarial request with x-test-bypass-user header when ENABLE_E2E_BYPASS is not true; must return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
finding.invariant: Admin-only actions are enforced server-side and in RLS, not just in the UI.

finding.exploit_scenario: Razorpay webhook handler validates HMAC signature and checks idempotency on gateway_payment_id, but does not enforce an event timestamp freshness window. Replay of non-payment or auxiliary failure events outside a 300s window could trigger redundant database lookups.
finding.required_fix: Add timestamp verification against payload created_at or header to enforce a 300-second replay tolerance window.
finding.acceptance_test: Send webhook event with created_at timestamp older than 300 seconds; verify it is rejected with 400 Replay tolerance exceeded.
finding.invariant: Every webhook is HMAC-verified, timestamp-checked, and idempotent.

finding.exploit_scenario: PostgreSQL SECURITY DEFINER functions audit shows: 0 NULL (unset), 151 Safe (70 empty string search_path="", 81 fixed standard public, private, pg_temp), and 9 utility functions with schemas (vault, net, extensions, pgmq). Since CREATE on all schemas is revoked from non-superusers, risk is Low.
finding.required_fix: Author a forward migration standardizing search_path on the remaining 9 functions to explicitly isolate search_path to public, private, pg_temp.
finding.acceptance_test: Query pg_proc for prosecdef = true and verify all functions have explicit immutable search_path.
finding.invariant: SECURITY DEFINER functions set a fixed search_path and check the caller.

finding.cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
finding.exploit_scenario: The 4-digit check-in PIN is stored as plaintext in public.appointment_checkin_codes(code). While RLS strictly isolates this table to customer_id = auth.uid() and merchant owners have 0 direct read access (zero columns readable via REST), plaintext storage at rest means a database snapshot or superadmin leak exposes check-in PINs.
finding.required_fix: Store check-in PIN as a cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256 with booking salt) and verify via hash comparison in verify_checkin_code RPC.
finding.acceptance_test: Assert appointment_checkin_codes.code contains hash digests instead of 4-digit plaintext strings.
finding.invariant: Authentication PINs and secrets are not stored in cleartext at rest.
finding.status: DEFERRED (Pending Human Approval: Plaintext 4-digit check-in PIN at rest)
